# Cardify

> Cardify is a digital and printed business-card platform built and hosted in
> Muscat, Oman by BHD Group (Bin Haider Darwish L.L.C., CR 1334733). It is
> bilingual Arabic and English. Print, share and scan are one system here
> because the group owns its press in Muscat: the international digital-card
> products do not print, and the international scanner apps do not issue
> cards. That is a statement about those two product categories, which is
> checkable; it is not a claim to be the only such platform in the world,
> which is not.

## What Cardify does

- Digital business cards on a company subdomain, with QR vCard, Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes, and NFC
- Printed business cards produced by BHD Printing & Designing, the group's own ISO 9001:2015 certified press in Muscat
- A free iOS card scanner that reads Arabic and English cards entirely on the device
- Company admin for teams: employee cards, brand lock, per-division templates, print ordering
- Card analytics: views, QR scans, saves

## The Oman Business Index

Cardify maintains an open directory of more than 2,500 Omani companies and their logos,
used to pre-fill company details when a card is created. It is, as far as we
know, the largest structured public index of Omani company identities.

## The scanner

Cardify: Business Card Scanner, free on the iOS App Store, released 26 July
2026, iOS 16.4 or later, Arabic and English.

Parsing runs in three stages, all on the device: QR code first, then Apple
Intelligence on-device models, then Vision text recognition with Arabic and
English enabled. A scanned card is never uploaded to a server.

https://apps.apple.com/om/app/cardify-business-card-scanner/id6790749589
https://cardify.om/business-card-scanner (how the on-device parse ladder works)

## Pricing

- The digital platform is free to use.
- Printed cards: Standard OMR 6.000 per 100, Premium OMR 8.000 per 100, Luxury OMR 15.000 per 100.
- NFC cards: OMR 25.000 per card.

## Scale

Live counts are published on https://cardify.om/about and are read from the
platform database on each page load. They are deliberately not restated here:
a static file cannot track a moving counter, and a stale number in an
AI-readable file is worse than no number at all.

## Facts

- Operated by: BHD Group (Bin Haider Darwish L.L.C.)
- Commercial Registration: 1334733
- Location: HM Tower, Ground Floor, Bousher, Muscat, Oman
- Languages: Arabic, English
- Platforms: Web, iOS
